name: io.github.diffbot/diffbot-mcp
title: Diffbot
description: Web search, page extraction, crawling, and Knowledge Graph queries from Diffbot's web index.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Diffbot token as 'Bearer <token>' for clients without OAuth. Free token: https://app.diffbot.com/get-started

environmentVariables.name: DIFFBOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Diffbot API token. Free token: https://app.diffbot.com/get-started. DIFFBOT_API_TOKEN or ~/.diffbot/credentials also work.
